			SELECT
			  product.id,
				product.name,
				product.brief,
				product.slug,
				product.amount,
				product.quantity,
				product.has_variants,
				product.active,
				product.digital,
				(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM digital_data WHERE digital_data.product_id = product.id AND digital_data.cart_id IS NULL) OR
				EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM digital_file WHERE digital_file.product_id = product.id)) AS digital_filled,
				(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id', product_image.id, 'name', product_image.name, 'ext', product_image.ext)) as images FROM product_image WHERE product_id = product.id) as image,
				(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id', product_variant.id, 'sku', product_variant.sku, 'quantity', product_variant.quantity, 'price_surcharge', product_variant.price_surcharge, 'option_values', json(product_variant.option_values), 'active', CASE WHEN product_variant.active = 1 THEN json('true') ELSE json('false') END)) FROM product_variant WHERE product_id = product.id) as variants,
				strftime('%s', created)
			FROM product
		 WHERE product.deleted = FALSE  ORDER BY product.created DESC, product.id
---
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product.id) FROM product WHERE product.deleted = FALSE 
---
SELECT id, key, value FROM setting WHERE key IN (?)
---

			SELECT
			  product.id,
				product.name,
				product.brief,
				product.slug,
				product.amount,
				product.quantity,
				product.has_variants,
				product.active,
				product.digital,
				(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM digital_data WHERE digital_data.product_id = product.id AND digital_data.cart_id IS NULL) OR
				EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM digital_file WHERE digital_file.product_id = product.id)) AS digital_filled,
				(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id', product_image.id, 'name', product_image.name, 'ext', product_image.ext)) as images FROM product_image WHERE product_id = product.id) as image,
				(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id', product_variant.id, 'sku', product_variant.sku, 'quantity', product_variant.quantity, 'price_surcharge', product_variant.price_surcharge, 'option_values', json(product_variant.option_values), 'active', CASE WHEN product_variant.active = 1 THEN json('true') ELSE json('false') END)) FROM product_variant WHERE product_id = product.id AND active = TRUE) as variants,
				strftime('%s', created)
			FROM product
		
			WHERE product.deleted = FALSE AND (
				product.active = TRUE
				OR EXISTS (
					SELECT 1 FROM digital_data
					WHERE digital_data.product_id = product.id
					AND digital_data.cart_id = ?
				)
			)
		 ORDER BY product.created DESC, product.id LIMIT ?
---
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product.id) FROM product
			WHERE product.deleted = FALSE AND (
				product.active = TRUE
				OR EXISTS (
					SELECT 1 FROM digital_data
					WHERE digital_data.product_id = product.id
					AND digital_data.cart_id = ?
				)
			)
		
---

			SELECT
				product.id,
				product.name,
				product.brief,
				product."desc",
				product.slug,
				product.amount,
				product.quantity,
				product.sku,
				product.has_variants,
				product.active,
				product.metadata,
				product.attribute,
				product.digital,
				product.seo,
				(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id', pi.id, 'name', pi.name, 'ext', pi.ext)) FROM product_image pi WHERE pi.product_id = product.id) as images,
				strftime('%s', product.created),
				strftime('%s', product.updated)
	, (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM digital_data WHERE digital_data.product_id = product.id AND digital_data.cart_id IS NULL) OR
				EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM digital_file WHERE digital_file.product_id = product.id)) AS digital_filled
			FROM product
			WHERE product.id = ?

			SELECT
				product.id,
				product.name,
				product.brief,
				product."desc",
				product.slug,
				product.amount,
				product.quantity,
				product.sku,
				product.has_variants,
				product.active,
				product.metadata,
				product.attribute,
				product.digital,
				product.seo,
				(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id', pi.id, 'name', pi.name, 'ext', pi.ext)) FROM product_image pi WHERE pi.product_id = product.id) as images,
				strftime('%s', product.created),
				strftime('%s', product.updated)
	
			FROM product
			WHERE product.slug = ? AND product.deleted = FALSE AND product.active = TRUE
---
SELECT id, name, ext FROM product_image WHERE product_id = ?
---

			SELECT 
					p.digital,
					df.id, df.name, df.ext,
					dd.id, dd.content, dd.cart_id
			FROM product p
			LEFT JOIN digital_file df ON p.id = df.product_id
			LEFT JOIN digital_data dd ON p.id = dd.product_id
			WHERE p.id = ?

	SELECT
		id,
		email,
		amount_total,
		currency,
		payment_id,
		payment_status,
		payment_system,
		strftime('%s', created),
		strftime('%s', updated)
	FROM cart
	ORDER BY created DESC
 LIMIT ?

    payment_id,

    strftime('%s', updated)
	FROM cart
	WHERE id = ?
